llm.summary: The skill is a coherent LINE sticker workflow, but it tells users to run an unpinned third-party npm project, which creates local code-execution supply-chain risk.

dimensions.detail: Following the optional local setup can execute mutable third-party JavaScript with the user's local permissions, which may expose files, environment variables, or developer credentials if run outside an isolated environment.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The README and SKILL instructions reference an external GitHub project and run npm install/npm run dev without pinning a reviewed commit, release, or dependency state.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The Taiwan Traditional Chinese defaults are clearly disclosed and fit the stated sticker-copy purpose; they are not hidden control instructions or session hijacking.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The inspected artifact does not request sudo, cron jobs, services, persistent memory writes, tool wrapping, credential harvesting, or destructive actions.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The core behavior is purpose-aligned: it plans LINE sticker sets, creates prompts, checks Traditional Chinese copy, and guides image slicing/background removal.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this skill only if you are comfortable reviewing or isolating the referenced line-sticker-factory project before running npm commands. Prefer a pinned commit or release, use a clean throwaway environment, and avoid exposing production credentials or sensitive files while running the external tool.
llm.findings:
[LP3] unexpected: The SKILL frontmatter lacks an explicit allowed-tools declaration, but the artifact is mostly narrative guidance; this is not enough by itself to justify Review.
[SQP-3] expected: The locale-specific Traditional Chinese guidance is prominent and aligned with the stated Taiwan LINE sticker-copy use case, so this scanner concern is downgraded.
[T08] expected: Using line-sticker-factory is purpose-aligned, but the documented unpinned GitHub/npm setup is a real supply-chain concern and is the basis for the Review verdict.
